# doh-stub

> Local DNS server in C++ that forwards every query over DNS-over-HTTPS (via WinHTTP) instead of plaintext UDP, so an ISP or DPI box only sees HTTPS traffic to the resolver.

Written for Windows, built with CMake and MSVC. Zero third-party dependencies, uses WinHTTP for the HTTPS leg.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/ImSavsis/doh-stub/blob/master/README.md): build and usage instructions, architecture diagram
- [src/main.cpp](https://github.com/ImSavsis/doh-stub/blob/master/src/main.cpp): UDP listener + DoH forwarding logic

## Notes

- No response caching, every query is a fresh HTTPS request
- Binding port 53 to replace the system resolver needs administrator rights
